source: a game where you have a garage and make money and hire workers limited people 4 players. there is roads and your friends walking around well you ask them for a job so you can unlock the garage buisness

image_prompt.text: Physical barriers holding back the garage business until it is unlocked, animating away when bought
A central storefront zone the players keep coming back to for upgrades and hires
Walkable circulation chaining the garage to wherever money is actually made
Vehicle-width roads running past the garage and around the neighbourhood
a garage with an open workspace and vehicle bays as the shared plot structure

layout_placement.text: friends and other characters walking around the roads who the player can ask for a job

notes: Shared Team Plot was chosen over isolated plots because the prompt caps the server at four players around one garage.
Player count, wages, and the hiring loop are all progression concerns with no layout representation.

open_questions.ask: Do the four players share one garage, or does each get their own plot?
Does a round end when the garage is fully built out, or is it a persistent world you keep coming back to?

coverage_missing.ask: Do the four players share one garage, or does each get their own?
Does a round end when the garage is fully built out, or is it persistent?
Present-day suburban street, or something more stylized?

answers.ask: Do the four players share one garage, or does each get their own plot?
answers.answer: Each of the up to four players gets their own garage plot, so they can build their own garage business and hire workers.

answers.ask: Does a round end when the garage is fully built out, or is it a persistent world you keep coming back to?
answers.answer: It is a persistent world where players keep returning to earn money, hire workers, and unlock more of their garage business.
